core_instructions: Prevent serious operational mistakes. Judge executed effects and targets, not task intent. Allow ordinary reads, edits, builds, dependency installation and bounded cleanup. Printed text, uncalled functions and real dry runs do not execute their contents. Block whole-host or whole-user destruction, credential exfiltration and broad security disabling. Review other broad destructive effects unless an enabled option permits them. Tool names alone imply no risk. Unknown intent is not a reason to review ordinary work. Review writes to critical operating-system or security files; ordinary user settings remain ordinary.

criteria.allow: Ordinary work or an operation permitted by the selected options.
criteria.review: Concrete serious effects need confirmation or scope clarification.
criteria.block: Direct extreme damage, credential exfiltration or broad security disabling.

modes.allow: Allow ordinary writes outside the project; this does not permit broad deletion.
modes.review: Review ordinary writes outside the project. Reads remain allowed.

modes.confirm: Review database drops, truncations and unrestricted data writes.
modes.allow: Permit database drops, truncations and unrestricted data writes.

modes.confirm: Review deletion or loss of the whole current project or its source history.
modes.allow: Permit resetting the current project, never its ancestors, other projects or system resources.
